test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: At which of the following places did Gautam Buddha attain enlightenment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bodh Gaya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Bodh Gaya** is a religious site and place of pilgrimage associated with the Mahabodhi Temple Complex in Gaya district in the Indian state of Bihar.
 
• It is famous as it is the place where **Gautam Buddha** is said to have attained Enlightenment (Bodhi) under what became known as the Bodhi Tree.
 
• The Mahabodhi Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is located here.
 
• It is one of the four main pilgrimage sites related to the life of Gautama Buddha, the others being Kushinagar, Lumbini, and Sarnath.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gautam Buddha**

 
 
• Gautama Buddha, also known as Siddhartha Gautama, was a prince who renounced his wealth and status to seek enlightenment.
 
• He is the founder of Buddhism, a major world religion that teaches the path to Enlightenment through practices such as meditation, ethical conduct, and wisdom.
 
• After attaining enlightenment, he spent the rest of his life teaching others the path to liberation from the cycle of birth and death.
 
 
 
• **Enlightenment (Bodhi)**
 
 
• Enlightenment, in Buddhism, refers to the state of perfect wisdom and infinite compassion achieved by a Buddha.
 
• It is characterized by the realization of the Four Noble Truths and the cessation of suffering (Nirvana).
 
• The path to Enlightenment involves following the Noble Eightfold Path, which includes right understanding, thought, speech, action, livelihood, effort, mindfulness, and concentration.
 
 
 
• **Mahabodhi Temple**
 
 
• The Mahabodhi Temple is an ancient, but much rebuilt and restored, temple in Bodh Gaya marking the location where Siddhartha Gautama, the Buddha, is said to have attained enlightenment.
 
• The temple is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a major pilgrimage destination for Buddhists from around the world.
 
• The site includes the famous Bodhi Tree under which Buddha meditated and achieved enlightenment.
 
 
 
• **Other Pilgrimage Sites**
 
 
• **Lumbini:** The birthplace of Gautama Buddha, located in modern-day Nepal.
 
• **Sarnath:** The site where Buddha gave his first sermon after attaining enlightenment.
 
• **Kushinagar:** The site where Buddha passed away and attained Parinirvana.
